answer: The raven schedule is applied in quartz and ocean exposes each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3397 identities would post 2105 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
